dogecoin.text:
Did you know that in 2015 the @ethereumfndn created a DAO to provide bounties to those who built a bridge between $DOGE and $ETH?

The contract is one of the earliest DAOs and still holds 50k MistCoin $WMC.

@VitalikButerin has two votes 🌌

Read more in the quoted tweet. 🧠 https://t.co/lYTVJuS0xh

The MistCoin lore never ends!

Likely completely unrelated, but two teams forked ZeroCoin and Dogecoin Core in 2014 and called it “mistcoin.”

They were probably never launched, but they may be the first reference to the name of what became the origin of all standard coins in https://t.co/cuH4JOK2qe
